entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your full name please?
Alex Chen.
Thanks, Alex. And which product are you calling about?
The VeloBand Pulse monitor.
Okay, I see your order right here, received 12 days ago. To start the process, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken. It's just really hard to use. The interface is not intuitive at all.
I see. I know new devices can be a bit confusing at first. Did you have a chance to review the quick-start section in the user manual? It often helps clarify the main functions.
I looked at the user manual. It didn't help. Honestly, I just expected more from a brand new device. It's not for me.
I understand completely. So just to confirm, there's no damage or defect, it's just not meeting your expectations?
Whatever. I just want my money back.
Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.

Alright, thanks for waiting, Alex. I've pulled up our policy. It looks like you received the item 12 days ago, and our system confirms all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the window for a full refund.
Fine. So what happens now?

I've just processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Simply pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
And the refund?
Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. That usually takes 3-5 business days after we get it back.
Great. So we're done?
Yes, that's everything. The email with the label is on its way. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a great rest of your day.
